claims.text: Mild travelers' diarrhea: abx ⍉recommended; loperamide or bismuth subsalicylate may be considered.
claims.quote: Antibiotic treatment is not recommended in patients with mild travelers' diarrhea, although loperamide or bismuth subsalicylate may be considered.

claims.text: Bismuth subsalicylate = an effective preventive option.
claims.quote: bismuth subsalicylate is an effective preventive option.

claims.text: Label: ⍉use in children/teens who have or are recovering from chickenpox or flu-like Sx (Reye's).
claims.quote: Reye's syndrome: Children and teenagers who have or are recovering from chicken pox or flu-like symptoms should not use this product.

claims.text: Ask a doctor or pharmacist first if on anticoagulation.
claims.quote: Ask a doctor or pharmacist before use if you are taking any drug for anticoagulation (thinning the blood)
